1 tbsp vegetable oil

1 tsp salt

2 tbsp flour

1 cup water

Dish:

Plate or platter

Salt

Rotten gram (garam masala)

Method:

Now to make the Aloo Tikki, using a teaspoon or your finger, make small round balls out of the dough and dip them into the water. You can also sprinkle them with salt or garam masala.

Arrange the Aloo Tikki on a plate or platter and serve. They go well with yogurt and chutney.
